viewport_notes: mobile: buy box reachable, sticky ATC a plus, variant/bundle chips don't overflow. desktop: gallery+buy-box side-by-side.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions or overlapping elements; nothing wraps or overflows the viewport (flex rows, long text); typography cascade intact (no wrong font/size/weight bleeding into a section); if the surface renders dark, text stays readable
product image + title + price + Add-to-Cart all visible above the fold in the rest frame (NOT obscured by any modal/banner)
price prominent; ATC the clear primary action; title is the H1
nothing past the right edge; variant/bundle selectors don't overflow
supporting sections (ingredients/reviews/ritual/FAQ) sit BELOW the buy box in the recipe order — never above it
deliberate gaps; no cramped collisions, no desolate voids
no missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no empty shells, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text, no copy typos in rendered text
consent/announcement chrome on-brand AND not covering any buy-box control
intentional premium per the niche scorecard, not a generic demo

the product title (H1) and any section headline stay visually contiguous on EVERY viewport — no decorative rule/divider/dash/border-pseudo-element splits a headline phrase into disconnected pieces (watch the mobile breakpoint).
product gallery / lifestyle imagery keeps its subject at EVERY viewport — the mobile crop shows the product, never a blank/subject-less patch from a desktop image cropped by the mobile container.
heading sizes descend h1 (title) > h2 > h3 at EVERY viewport — no inversion (a section h2 larger than the product title) and no flattening on mobile reflow.
decorative elements (trust badges, dividers, accent shapes) are intentional, aligned, and present at every viewport — none missing, clipped, or misaligned.
variant selectors + ATC show a visible focus state and a logical order; the ATC is reachable. Flag invisible focus or an ATC lost against the background.

mobile_overlay.rule: on mobile the Add-to-Cart stays reachable as the shopper scrolls (sticky bar or repeated CTA) — not stranded above a long PDP
variant chips, quantity, and ATC are ≥44px and not crammed together — comfortably tappable with a thumb
the primary ATC sits within comfortable thumb reach (lower two-thirds) in the rest frame, not only at the very top
